item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Under pressure from President Trump, can the filibuster survive 2026?
item.summary: President Trump wants to do away with the filibuster in order to pass the Save America Act. But many Senate Republicans are reluctant, wary of what it would mean if they were to lose their majority.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] They counted on a rural dialysis unit to keep them alive. Then it closed
item.summary: A hospital in Nebraska shut down the only dialysis unit for miles, upending lives. That's despite a new federal program that gave the state more than $200 million to improve rural health care access.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] 'No peace': Nearly a year after her son's death, she learned that ICE was responsible
item.summary: Ruben Ray Martinez is considered the first person to be killed by ICE during President Trump's second term. His mother believes his death could have been avoided.

item.title: Justice Department moves to toss conspiracy convictions for Jan. 6 rioters
item.summary: The Justice Department on Tuesday asked a federal appeals court to throw out the seditious conspiracy convictions of Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders, for their role in the Jan. 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol attack.

item.title: Justice Department says Biden DOJ weaponized law to go after anti-abortion activists
item.summary: The Trump administration has said that enforcement of the FACE Act by the Biden DOJ represents "the prototypical example" of the weaponization of the law against conservatives.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Pope heads to Cameroon as separatists announce 3-day pause in fighting
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV is heading to the central African nation of Cameroon with a message of peace for its separatist region and for talks with President Paul Biya.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] No one likes being discombobulated. How did the feeling get such a fun name?
item.summary: Sometimes you just need to recombobulate. That word isn't in the dictionary, but it is on a beloved sign at Milwaukee's airport.

item.title: Raffle winner thrilled to claim a $1 million Picasso with a $117 ticket
item.summary: "How do I check that it's not a hoax?" said Ari Hodara. The Parisian art enthusiast could not believe his luck when he found out he'd won a Pablo Picasso painting worth $1 million.

item.title: Super Typhoon Sinlaku pounds remote U.S. islands in the Pacific Ocean
item.summary: A super typhoon steadily battered a pair of remote U.S. islands in the Pacific Ocean with ferocious winds and relentless rains, shredding tin roofs and forcing residents to take cover.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Quit a GLP-1? Plan to start again? It's not recommended, but plenty of people do it
item.summary: A majority of people who start the obesity and diabetes medicines known as GLP-1s also quit them, and plan to restart again. Research hasn't yet shown the health impacts of cycling on and off the drugs.
